svg.aria-label: Exact ODE paths of six crescent samples against noise level, straight above σ = 20 and below σ = 5 and bending between, with DDIM's six-step chords cutting across the bend
svg.text: EXACT ODE PATHS OF SIX SAMPLES (LINES) AND DDIM WITH SIX STEPS (DASHED), 32×32 CRESCENTS
NOISE LEVEL σ (SAMPLING RUNS LEFT TO RIGHT)
NOISE LEVEL σ (SAMPLING RUNS LEFT TO RIGHT)
Measured with the exact denoiser. Crescent coordinate: projection on the difference of two opposite crescents; brightness: on all-ones.
DDIM's six steps land at σ = 24.4, 5.84, 0.965, 0.0851, 0.002, then 0 (EDM's ρ = 7 grid from σ = 80).
